# Async Interview

Async Interview is an on-demand video interview platform that streamlines the hiring process by allowing candidates to respond to pre-recorded questions at their convenience, enabling employers to review responses asynchronously.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/async-interview/.

## Actions

- **Delete Job**: Delete an interview job.
- **List Jobs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all interview jobs.
- **Update Job**: Update an existing interview job.
